name: ceo-tools
description: MCP tools for CEAuto Autonomous CEO Agent

tools.name: ceo_boot
tools.description: Run CEO boot sequence — reads all state files, injects 7-day SQLite summary, returns standup briefing

tools.name: ceo_delegate
tools.description: Delegate a task to a sub-agent — logs to in-progress.md + SQLite, writes directive

depends_on.description: Task ids that must be done before this task is scheduled (DAG). The heartbeat only runs a task once all its deps are done; a missing dep or a cycle blocks the task with a reason.

parent_id.description: Parent task id when this is a subtask of a larger task

context_files.description: Files to include as context for the agent

success_criteria.description: Definition of done for this task

execute.description: If true, immediately run the task through the agent's LLM (approval-first: defaults to false)

needs_approval.description: If true, the task cannot be executed (manually or by the daemon) until a human approves it via ceo_resolve_approval

tools.name: ceo_run_task
tools.description: Execute a previously delegated task — claims it atomically, dispatches to the agent's LLM under budget control, writes the result, and marks it done

task_id.description: ID of the task to run

tools.name: ceo_decide
tools.description: Log a CEO decision with persona and rationale — writes to decisions.md + SQLite

tools.name: ceo_generate_standup
tools.description: Generate daily standup report — reads all task state, writes reports/standup.md

date.description: Date for standup (YYYY-MM-DD), defaults to today

tools.name: ceo_create_directive
tools.description: Issue a structured YAML directive to a sub-agent — appends to comms/directives.md

tools.name: ceo_report_blocker
tools.description: Flag a task as blocked — writes to blocked.md + SQLite, logs to agent-logs.md

tools.name: ceo_complete_task
tools.description: Mark a task as done — moves from in-progress.md to done.md + SQLite

tools.name: ceo_run_cycle
tools.description: Run one autonomous heartbeat cycle — claims and executes up to max_tasks_per_cycle actionable tasks under budget control, self-evaluates, and logs. The same cycle the daemon runs on a schedule.

tools.name: ceo_metrics
tools.description: Report autonomy metrics — task throughput, token/USD spend, decisions, pending approvals, and average self-eval score. Also writes reports/metrics.md.

tools.name: ceo_org
tools.description: Show the org chart from config/org.yaml — roles, reporting lines, members, each role's daily budget envelope, and today's spend rolled up across the role's subtree.

tools.name: ceo_request_approval
tools.description: Open a human approval request (strategic decision, sensitive action, or budget overage). The daemon will not execute the referenced item until approved.

ref_id.description: ID of the decision/task this gates

tools.name: ceo_resolve_approval
tools.description: Approve or reject a pending approval. Approving a budget hold also resumes autonomous spend.

tools.name: ceo_list_approvals
tools.description: List approvals, optionally filtered by status (pending/approved/rejected)

tools.name: ceo_recall
tools.description: Full-text search across all SQLite memory — decisions, agent outputs, events, directives

type.description: Narrow search to specific record type

tools.name: ceo_workflow
tools.description: Execute a multi-agent workflow chain — runs steps sequentially/parallel, passes outputs as context

name.description: Workflow name (matches filename in workflows/ without .md)

goal.description: High-level goal for this workflow run

params.description: Additional parameters to inject into workflow steps
